name: Shore Pier · Round 1
domainSummary: A reusable T-shaped pier defined by a long narrow pile-supported approach, broad cross-head deck, repeated structural posts, one tiny blank utility shelter, and a stepped landward abutment.
evidenceBoundary: Keep the pier generic and unowned. Do not imply port, route, vessel capacity, cargo activity, shoreline location, occupancy, or a real facility.

researchSources.title: Career World canonical ambient briefs
researchSources.use: Accepted T plan, piles, shelter, abutment, projection, and neutral-evidence boundary.

assets.name: Shore Pier · Canonical Production
assets.controlledVariable: refine the accepted baseline into its clearest production-ready map prop; emphasize clear T-shaped plan
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested in its most resolved reusable form. This version emphasizes clear T-shaped plan.

assets.name: Shore Pier · Silhouette Contrast
assets.controlledVariable: push the outer contour and negative spaces for instant recognition at map scale; emphasize pile-supported narrow approach
assets.thesis: A distinct silhouette tests recognition without labels or color. This version emphasizes pile-supported narrow approach.

assets.name: Shore Pier · Weighted Asymmetry
assets.controlledVariable: shift the dominant mass off-center while preserving the asset's practical balance; emphasize broad cross-head deck
assets.thesis: Controlled asymmetry creates identity without sacrificing function. This version emphasizes broad cross-head deck.

assets.name: Shore Pier · Functional Exposure
assets.controlledVariable: make the asset's defining working parts structurally legible without diagrams; emphasize one tiny blank utility shelter
assets.thesis: Exposed function tests whether the object reads through construction rather than decoration. This version emphasizes one tiny blank utility shelter.

assets.name: Shore Pier · Rugged Structure
assets.controlledVariable: strengthen load-bearing edges, joints, guards, and contact points; emphasize stepped landward abutment
assets.thesis: Rugged construction tests a durable working-world interpretation. This version emphasizes stepped landward abutment.

assets.name: Shore Pier · Modular Rhythm
assets.controlledVariable: organize repeated functional elements into a clear unequal rhythm on one coherent object or shared base; emphasize clear T-shaped plan
assets.thesis: A modular cadence tests reuse and system belonging. This version emphasizes clear T-shaped plan.

assets.name: Shore Pier · Low Profile
assets.controlledVariable: compress height and emphasize a long stable footprint while retaining every defining feature; emphasize pile-supported narrow approach
assets.thesis: A low profile tests legibility in dense map placement. This version emphasizes pile-supported narrow approach.

assets.name: Shore Pier · Vertical Accent
assets.controlledVariable: give one legitimate functional element a taller focal role while keeping the overall prop subordinate to buildings; emphasize broad cross-head deck
assets.thesis: A vertical accent tests landmark readability without turning the prop into architecture. This version emphasizes broad cross-head deck.

assets.name: Shore Pier · Compact Primitive
assets.controlledVariable: reduce the asset to the smallest complete form that preserves its exact identity and component count; emphasize one tiny blank utility shelter
assets.thesis: The primitive reveals which cues are essential. This version emphasizes one tiny blank utility shelter.

assets.name: Shore Pier · Ambient Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance silhouette, function, construction, modular detail, and map-scale restraint in one production-ready prop; emphasize stepped landward abutment
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests the complete ambient identity for repeated world use. This version emphasizes stepped landward abutment.
